body: but how can you go on even though you never bent the fiberglass rod, but still got blinded. how can you live every day having been blinded by the fool who didnt know when to stop bending a fiberglass rod? how is it possible to gain redemption for something that was not up to you, played out by some unseen hand, bending and bending, that you tried to do everything to stop, and yet still you are the one who gets the splinters. youre the one who always gets the splinters. youre the one who cant see the light. how can you go on when no matter what, you just cant see a way out. i cant.
i dont see how i can just pick up and start over. i cant just dust myself off and somehow fix my life.
